Use case: character replacement in an existing animation sprite sheet. This is NOT a new animation.
Image 1 = the EDIT TARGET: exactly 12 consecutive animation poses in a grid of FOUR columns by THREE rows of equal square cells, read left to right, top to bottom. It shows an OLD character (white tiger cub in a blue polo shirt and dark trousers).
Image 2 = the NEW character: the BAM mascot. Chibi snow leopard cub, white fluffy fur with grey rosette spots, big bright blue eyes, pink nose, blue over-ear headset with boom mic and "AI" on the ear cup, deep navy padded techwear jumpsuit with royal blue #2741FA shoulder/arm/knee panels and thin soft periwinkle-white glowing seams, round #2741FA chest badge with white "BAM", utility belt with a square "A" buckle, white high-top sneakers with #2741FA panels, thick ringed snow-leopard tail.
Image 3 = the FINISHED first sheet of this same animation with the new character. Match its character rendering, size, proportions and colours exactly so the sheets join seamlessly.

This sheet = frames 60-71: lower and roll the open paper into the paw at viewer left; then the free arm at viewer right gradually extends to a final open upward-facing palm. Last pose: open palm at viewer right, rolled paper at viewer left.

Replace the old character in EVERY cell with the Image 2 character. Preserve, cell by cell: the exact pose and joint angles, the held prop and its position, the cell order, the body scale, the foot baseline and the horizontal position, so the frames still play as smooth animation. The SAME character in all 12 cells: identical size, outfit, colours and markings. Never draw tiger stripes, a polo shirt, trousers or amber eyes.
Output 1448 x 1086 pixels (4:3), FOUR columns by THREE rows of 362 x 362 cells. Each cell holds exactly one complete character with a small clean margin; nothing crosses a cell border. Sharp native detail, no motion blur, no glow halos. Real alpha-transparent background: no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow, no checkerboard, no grid lines. No text other than "BAM", "AI" and "A" on the outfit.
prompts.qr-board:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create exactly ONE image. Do not write code, do not run shell commands, do not edit files. After the image is generated, reply only "done".

Use case: character replacement in an existing print asset.
Image 1 = the EDIT TARGET: a mascot peeking over the top of a large blank white board and gripping its two top corners. It shows an OLD character (white tiger cub in a blue polo). Keep the composition exactly: the same canvas framing, the large blank white rounded-rectangle board with a thin dark navy border at the same size and position, the head and shoulders above the board centred at the same place, and the two paws gripping the board's top-left and top-right corners at the same place and size.
Image 2 = the NEW character: the BAM mascot. Chibi snow leopard cub, white fluffy fur with grey rosette spots, big bright blue eyes, pink nose, blue over-ear headset with boom mic and "AI" on the ear cup, deep navy padded techwear jumpsuit with royal blue #2741FA shoulder panels and thin soft periwinkle-white glowing seams, round #2741FA chest badge with white "BAM" just visible above the board edge.

Replace the old character with the Image 2 character: happy open-mouth smile, eyes on the viewer, head tilted slightly as in the target. White furry paws with grey spots gripping the corners. Never draw tiger stripes, a polo shirt or amber eyes. The board stays pure blank white inside, with nothing drawn on it.
Output 1072 x 1464 pixels portrait. Real alpha-transparent background around the character and board: no backdrop, no cast shadow, no checkerboard. No text other than "BAM" on the badge and "AI" on the ear cup.
